scenes.visual_broll_prompt: Cinematic 4K drone shot of Tata Intra EV fleet driving across Lucknow-Kanpur industrial expressway at sunrise
scenes.on_screen_text_english: Chapter 1: The ₹100B Indian Commercial EV Revolution
scenes.voiceover_script_english: Commercial electric vehicles are transforming Indian logistics. But high battery depreciation and finance costs break most fleet operators. Here is how Vision Loop engineered an autonomous, self-sustaining model.
scenes.voiceover_script_hindi: कमर्शियल इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन भारतीय लॉजिस्टिक्स को बदल रहे हैं। लेकिन बैटरी डिप्रिसिएशन और भारी ब्याज ऑपरेटरों को नुकसान पहुंचाते हैं। देखिए कैसे Vision Loop ने एक ऑटोनॉमस और टिकाऊ मॉडल बनाया।
scenes.animation_notes: Lower-third title banner with animated episode chapter marks

scenes.visual_broll_prompt: Detailed walkthrough of SAC 997311 invoicing, 18% GST equality split, and 100% Section 17(5)(a) Input Tax Credit recovery
scenes.voiceover_script_english: By structuring contracts under SAC 997311, enterprise clients recover 100% of GST under Section 17(5)(a), reducing effective monthly fleet costs while maintaining statutory perfection.
scenes.voiceover_script_hindi: SAC 997311 के तहत अनुबंध संरचना करके, कॉर्पोरेट ग्राहक धारा 17(5)(a) के तहत 100% GST इनपुट क्रेडिट वापस प्राप्त करते हैं।
scenes.animation_notes: Split-screen breakdown of CGST ₹6,480 + SGST ₹6,480 on ₹72k Base

scenes.visual_broll_prompt: 3D interactive simulation of the 15% Sinking Fund reserve accumulating ₹3.88 Lakhs at ~6.8% CAGR by Month 36
scenes.on_screen_text_english: Chapter 3: Sinking Fund Mathematics — Debt-Free Asset Replacement
scenes.voiceover_script_english: Instead of paying loan interest to banks, Vision Loop sweeps 15% of revenue into liquid overnight treasury funds, completely self-funding battery and vehicle upgrades.
scenes.voiceover_script_hindi: बैंकों को ब्याज देने के बजाय, Vision Loop 15% रेवेन्यू को लिक्विड ट्रेजरी फंड में निवेश करता है, जिससे 36वें महीने में बिना लोन के नया वाहन आ जाता है।
scenes.animation_notes: Exponential compound growth curve chart overlay

scenes.visual_broll_prompt: Live telematics dashboard, CAN-Bus battery telemetry, standstill immobilizer lockout demonstration, and concluding call to action
scenes.on_screen_text_english: Chapter 4: Live Telematics & Autonomous AI Swarm Governance
scenes.voiceover_script_english: Every vehicle is monitored by autonomous AI sentinels ensuring safety and 99.4% battery health. Explore our open architecture at visionloop.in.
scenes.voiceover_script_hindi: प्रत्येक वाहन की सुरक्षा और 99.4% बैटरी हेल्थ हमारे AI सेंटिनल्स द्वारा 24/7 सुरक्षित रखी जाती है।
scenes.animation_notes: End-screen cards linking to next video and Telegram bot

longform.description_english:
In this comprehensive deep-dive, we break down how Vision Loop operates commercial EV assets in Lucknow, UP using SAC 997311 GST structures, 15% Sinking Funds, and CAN-Bus battery telematics.

📌 CHAPTERS:
00:00 - The Commercial EV Opportunity in India
01:00 - SAC 997311 Invoicing & 100% ITC Recovery
04:00 - 15% Sinking Fund Mathematics (~6.8% CAGR)
07:00 - CAN-Bus Battery SLA & Standstill Safety Guardrail
09:30 - Conclusion & Open Architecture Access

🌐 Website: https://visionloop-org.github.io/visionloop/
🤖 Telegram Bot: https://t.me/VisionLoop_Bot
